summary: Verified annotation tools bug fix. Arrow, circle, and rectangle annotations now persist correctly after drawing. The fix changed condition from `annotationPoints.length > 2` to `annotationPoints.length >= 2` in SlideCanvas.jsx handleMouseUp function. All annotation types work correctly and are included in SCORM export.

✅ Annotation API - POST create rectangle annotation

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Annotation tools (arrows, circles, rectangles) were disappearing after being drawn
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Condition `annotationPoints.length > 2` required more than 2 points, but shapes like arrow, circle, rectangle only use 2 points (start and end)
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Changed to `annotationPoints.length >= 2` with dynamic minPoints based on annotation type (freehand=3, shapes=2)
evidence: Console logs show 'Annotation saved: arrow 2 points'
Console logs show 'Annotation saved: circle 2 points'
Console logs show 'Annotation saved: rectangle 2 points'
Annotations visible on canvas after drawing
SCORM export includes annotations with correct structure

seed_data_creation: Used existing project 'Teste de conversor PPT' with 6 slides. Created test annotations during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Annotation tools are fully working. The fix was in SlideCanvas.jsx handleMouseUp function - changed condition from `> 2` to `>= 2` for shapes. All annotation types (arrow, circle, rectangle, freehand) work correctly. SCORM export includes annotations with proper rendering in player.js.
